store._comment: Ficha de la App Store por idioma (base: lo publicado en la 1.0, con los cambios de setup-v2 §1.1, §1.2 y §1.8). whatsNew y reviewNotes se confirman contra el build de TestFlight antes de enviar.

en-US.name: HoboEvolution
en-US.description:
Tap, merge and evolve: from neighborhood hobo to God of the universe, with stops at the corner store, the delivery bike, the office and a university diploma (doesn't pay rent, but feels great).

• +30 evolution tiers with your chosen career: coder, architect, doctor or lawyer
• Passive income: your characters work so you don't have to
• Absurd economy events inspired by very real chaos
• Visitors with requests, a prize wheel, the Mattress Stash and Customs Parcels
• Special characters: from the Crypto Bro to the Tax Demon
• Reincarnate: every life starts faster and weirder
• Offline progress: your empire keeps spinning while you sleep
• Now on iPad too
en-US.keywords: hobo merge idle clicker tycoon evolution tap money rich god upgrade prestige meme funny
en-US.promotionalText: Tap, merge and evolve: from neighborhood hobo to God of the universe, with stops at the corner store, the delivery bike, the office and a university diploma
en-US.whatsNew:
Version 2.0 is here: the biggest overhaul since the Hobo left the alley.

• Visitors: the Police Chief, the Union Boss, the Gringo Tourist and friends drop by with requests, trades and surprises.
• New events like We Won the Cup!, Long Weekend, General Strike and Blackout, each with a way out by video.
• Customs Parcels, the Mattress Stash and the TV Host's Prize Wheel.
• Blue Dollar Shop: boosts, shortcuts, permanent upgrades and new outfits.
• 15 spots per floor, an elevator panel, and fully staffed floors that boost your income.
• The quick-hire button never disappears, and pressing and holding it lets you pin who you hire.
• A music theme for every floor.
• Now on iPad too.
• A brand-new tutorial, plus a tour of what's new for 1.0 veterans.
• Fixes: background earnings no longer freeze, and no evolution happens without you seeing it.

es-MX.name: FisuEvolution
es-MX.description:
Tapeá, mergeá y evolucioná: de El Fisura del barrio a Dios del universo, con escalas en el kiosco, el delivery, la oficina y el título de la UBA (que no paga el alquiler, pero emociona).

• 30 niveles de evolución con la carrera que elijas: programador, arquitecto, médico o abogado
• Ingresos pasivos: tus personajes laburan solos (más que algunos conocidos)
• Eventos argentinos: Plan Platita, Devaluación, Se cayó el home banking, Corralito, Paro General y el Aguinaldo
• Visitantes con pedidos, la Ruleta, El Colchón y el Paquete de la Aduana
• Personajes especiales: del Crypto Bro al Demonio de ARCA
• Reencarná: cada vida arranca más rápida y más absurda
• Jugá offline: tu imperio sigue girando mientras dormís
• Ahora también en iPad

Gratis, con humor y sin vergüenza. La inflación no perdona; vos sí podés ganar.

es-MX.promotionalText: De fisura a dios del universo. Tocá para ganar monedas, fusioná personajes y subí niveles sin parar. ¿Hasta dónde llegás?

store.reviewNotes:
HoboEvolution 2.0 - notes for the reviewer

Satirical single-player merge/idle game with Argentine humor. Brands are parodies and characters are archetypes, not real people. No accounts, no login: progress is stored on device. The only server of ours is the optional leaderboard (see LEADERBOARD). Game Center and iCloud are disabled.

LEADERBOARD (Guideline 1.2)
The Ranking tab is in the bottom bar right after the tutorial: open it to see the board; long-press any row for Report. Entering a name is only offered after reaching the final stage (God), which takes hours, so it is not reachable in review. It is optional; the name (max 15 chars) is checked by rules, a word list and an automated classifier (Anthropic's Claude Haiku, which receives only the name), and hidden after 3 reports.

HOW TO TEST
Tap the character to earn coins, tap Hire to buy another one, and drag one onto another to merge them. The tutorial cannot be skipped; it ends with a welcome chest. The bottom-bar tabs appear one by one as you play. The Store tab has every IAP and Restore Purchases.

ADS (Google AdMob; mediation partners: Unity Ads and Meta Audience Network)
1. Opt-in rewarded videos, always started by an explicit tap on a button that says what you get; they never autoplay. Places: the Gifts list (4 prizes, and skipping a boost cooldown); the side column of the board ("Merge all" and parcel rain); doubling offline earnings; opening another skin chest; the prize wheel (spin and "repeat prize"); the Mattress Stash (open and "another mattress"); visitors (reward x2, forgiving a fine, the street vendor's boosts, the x2 challenge); escaping a negative event; daily and career rewards x2.
2. Ads that appear on their own, only at natural breaks: at least 2 minutes apart, never during the tutorial, never over an open screen or a celebration, never two in the same break.
- Interstitial and "ad break" (rewarded interstitial) alternate. Breaks: closing a menu screen back to the board, dismissing the offline-earnings popup, reincarnating, and the end of a chain of celebrations. The ad break always shows an intro with a 5-second countdown and a visible "No, thanks" button; declining has no penalty.
- App open: only when returning after 3+ minutes away, at most once every 20 minutes, from the second session on, never on first launch or in the tutorial.
"Remove Ads" (US$2.99) and the Starter Pack remove these three formats. Opt-in rewarded videos stay, because they are optional and pay out prizes; the purchase description says so.
ATT is requested on first launch; declining is fully supported. In the EEA, UK and Switzerland, Google's UMP consent form is shown before any ad, and Settings > Privacy options lets the player change it.

RANDOMIZED ITEMS (Guideline 3.1.1)
The prize wheel, the skin chest bought with Blue Dollars, the Mattress Stash and the skin chest in the Welcome Pack give randomized items. The odds of every prize are shown on screen before spinning, buying or opening. Blue Dollars, the premium currency, can be bought with real money; it has no real-world value and cannot be cashed out or transferred. No real-money gambling or betting. Extra wheel spins and skin chests bought with Blue Dollars are off in Belgium and Australia.

24-HOUR OFFERS (consumable IAPs)
- Welcome Pack (US$0.99): once, on the player's 2nd calendar day. To see it: play once, set the device date one day ahead and reopen the app.
- Rebirth Pack (US$2.99): right after reincarnating.
- Moving Day Pack (US$4.99): when a new floor opens outside the tutorial; early floors open within the first minutes.
Each stays for 24 hours behind a chip at the top of the board, never during the tutorial.

IAPs (14): starter pack, remove ads, three cash packs, three Blue Dollar packs, three skin purchases and the three offers above. Consumables are not restored by design; remove ads and skins are.
